NO thin string-like shins, NO sharply tapering leaf shapes, NO pointed claws. These are ordinary flexible walking tissues, not generic insect legs, armor, fins, caterpillar bodies or bones. Controlled large pixel clusters, no gloss, no geometric capsule, no repeated tiled marks, no gradients or tiny painted texture.
